use_case: Patrol app AI report assistant: drafts incident reports from the owner's voice notes, assigns an incident type, and assigns a priority that decided whether the client was alerted at once (Immediate) or in the 6:30 a.m. daily report (Routine)
vendor_or_model: Patrol app vendor (generative speech-to-text and language model from a third-party AI model provider, carved out of the vendor's SOC 2 report)
data_categories: Voice notes; transcripts; draft reports naming people, with descriptions, vehicle details, and sometimes ID numbers or injury notes; site addresses; photos
human_in_the_loop: Before 2026-08-31: owner read drafts but the AI priority sent or withheld client alerts automatically. From 2026-08-24: owner sets the priority on every report, reads every draft in full before submitting, and phones the client for any fire, water, intrusion, injury, or police event
applicable_laws: Fla. Stat. 493.6119(4) (no false reports); Fla. Stat. 493.6118(1)(e) (unauthorized release); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) and (6)(a) (reasonable measures; third-party agent notice); client agreements (confidentiality; incident notice)
status: In production with conditions (drafting only; AI priority no longer used to decide client alerts; training opt-out set 2026-08-12)
